title: Summer Music Festival
description: Join us for an unforgettable night of live music featuring local and international artists. Experience the best of electronic, indie, and rock music under the stars. Food trucks and drinks available throughout the evening. This is a family-friendly event with activities for all ages.

title: Tech Talks: AI & Future
description: Explore the latest developments in artificial intelligence and machine learning. Industry leaders will share insights on how AI is transforming businesses and society. Network with fellow tech enthusiasts and innovators. Panel discussion and Q&A session included.

title: Art Gallery Opening
description: Contemporary art exhibition featuring works by emerging Estonian artists. Explore diverse mediums including paintings, sculptures, and digital installations. Meet the artists and enjoy complimentary refreshments. First 50 guests receive a limited edition poster.

title: Stand-Up Comedy Night
description: Get ready to laugh until your sides hurt with some of Estonia's funniest comedians. Three headliners and two up-and-coming acts will keep you entertained all night long. Bar open throughout the show. Ages 18+ only.

title: Yoga in the Park
description: Start your weekend with a refreshing outdoor yoga session suitable for all levels. Bring your own mat and enjoy the peaceful surroundings of Toomemägi. Professional instructor will guide you through various poses and breathing techniques. Weather permitting.

title: Food Truck Festival
description: Taste your way through dozens of international cuisines at our annual food truck festival. From authentic Asian street food to gourmet burgers and vegan delights, there's something for everyone. Live music and kids' activities throughout the day.

title: Classical Music Concert
description: Experience the beauty of classical music performed by the Tartu Symphony Orchestra. Program includes works by Bach, Mozart, and Beethoven. World-renowned conductor guest appearance. Formal attire recommended but not required.

title: Startup Pitch Night
description: Watch innovative startups pitch their ideas to a panel of investors and industry experts. Network with entrepreneurs, investors, and tech professionals. Vote for your favorite pitch and help decide the People's Choice Award winner.

title: Christmas Market Opening
description: Kick off the holiday season at Tartu's traditional Christmas market. Shop for unique handcrafted gifts, enjoy festive foods and drinks, and soak in the magical atmosphere. Santa will be making appearances throughout the day. Opening ceremony at 5 PM.

title: Wine Tasting Evening
description: Discover exquisite wines from around the world guided by a certified sommelier. Sample 8 different wines paired with artisanal cheeses and charcuterie. Learn about wine regions, production methods, and tasting techniques. Limited seating available.

title: Board Game Night
description: Join fellow board game enthusiasts for an evening of strategy, fun, and friendly competition. Over 100 games available to play. Beginners welcome - our staff will teach you any game. Snacks and drinks available for purchase.

title: Jazz Night at the Cellar
description: Intimate jazz performance in an atmospheric cellar venue. Local jazz quartet will play standards and original compositions. Limited seating creates an up-close and personal experience. Pre-booking strongly recommended.
